news.headline: Hall of Famer Jack Ham returning to broadcast booth after health scare
news.description: Hall of Fame linebacker and Penn State radio analyst Jack Ham will return to the broadcast booth on Saturday, just two weeks after suffering a medical emergency.

news.headline: Vikings' Cousins channeling Dantonio's 'slow down' maxim amid whirlwind month
news.description: As he manages the whirlwind of his professional and personal life this month, Vikings QB Kirk Cousins has relied on a maxim he often heard from his college coach Mark Dantonio at Michigan State -- when things speed up, try to slow down.

news.headline: Studies: Blood test has potential to detect CTE in the living
news.description: A new blood test shows potential to detect advanced stages of chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) in the living, according to two recent published studies.

transactions.text: Signed DT Aidan Keanaaina to the practice squad. Released DT Chris Smith from the practice squad.
Waived DT Aidan Keanaaina. Reverted RB Kye Robichaux and DB Loren Strickland to injured reserve after they cleared waivers.
Signed QB Joshua Dobbs to a one-year contract. Released TE Anthony Firkser. Waived DB De'Shawn Rucker. Placed DT Aidan Keanaaina on injured reserve.

Signed T Blake Miller, DE Derrick Moore, LB Jimmy Rolder, DB Keith Abney II, WR Kendrick Law and DTs Skyler Gill-Howard and Tyre West to rookie contracts. Signed QB Luke Altmyer, T Melvin Priestly, TE Miles Kitselman, DT Aidan Keanaaina, DEsAnthony Lucas and Eric O'Neil, DE Erick Hunter and DBs Aamaris Brown and De'Shawn Rucker to UDFA contracts.

insights: Entered the league in 2026 as an undrafted free agent.
